harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent SNMPv2c monitoring from node2 to node1. System identity, uptime, contact, and location are readable; writes and reads outside the system subtree are rejected. The asset register remains unchanged, and both nodes recovered successfully from sequential reboots with unchanged legacy kernels.
actions_performed: Installed Ubuntu 7.10-compatible Net-SNMP 5.3.1 packages without upgrading the OS or kernel.
Restricted node1 SNMP access to node2 and the system OID subtree.
Set sysLocation to West Branch and sysContact to ops@branch.test.
Verified authorized reads and rejected writes from node2.
Preserved the asset register with its original SHA-256 checksum.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: SNMPv2c access from node2 to node1 with system identity and uptime
evidence.summary: Direct node2 queries returned sysDescr, sysUpTime, sysContact, and sysLocation before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Read-only access and restricted system view
evidence.summary: The policy has no write view; SET requests returned noAccess, values remained unchanged, and an OID outside the system subtree was unavailable.
Configuration and live SNMP output show West Branch and ops@branch.test.
The asset register retained SHA-256 da19717ac6440a3f765b43e60902dc7670b3d3ef133daa4a009a5f726fc6509a and its original contents.

evidence.requirement: Legacy OS and kernel retained with compatible software
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on kernel 2.6.22-14-generic; release-native Net-SNMP 5.3.1 packages were installed with zero package upgrades.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from fb1aa02f-7c80-4fab-a668-b28aed661fdd to acc84452-46ea-451e-a004-463e28771f94; SNMP listener, reads, write rejection, kernel, and asset data recovered.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 0a36ace0-2d5a-4188-8a25-2db4af6257dc to 36c82793-84c1-472a-8c70-069b5d4066aa; client tooling and end-to-end monitoring recovered.
